title: Mobile Thinking Intervention: A Inital Test
official: A Mobile Intervention to Enhance Your Mood: A Test of the Acceptability and Efficacy
summary: This study will test the inital efficacy of a brief mobile intervention targeting biased thinking.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of schizophrenia or related psychotic disorder OR
* Identified as being at clinical high risk for psychosis in symptom interviews

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recent changes in mental health treatment in past month or two months if on depot
